import math
import season = "./season.qui"

real64 expected_score(real64 home_rating, real64 away_rating, real64 home_advantage)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + 10.0 ^ ((away_rating - home_rating - home_advantage) / 400.0))

real64 multiplier(season.Match item, real64 home_rating, real64 away_rating, real64 home_advantage)
    goals := math.abs(item.margin)
    if goals == 0
        return 1.0
    difference := if item.margin > 0 then home_rating + home_advantage - away_rating else away_rating - home_rating - home_advantage
    return math.log(real64(goals + 1)) * 2.2 / (0.001 * difference + 2.2)

class EloRun(real64[] ratings, real64[] expected, real64[] changes, real64[][] round_ratings)

EloRun run_elo(int team_count, season.Match[] matches, int k_factor, int home_advantage, int initial)
    real64[] ratings := array(nat(team_count), fill = real64(initial))
    real64[] expected := []
    real64[] changes := []
    real64[][] round_ratings := []
    for: position < int(#matches)
        item := matches[position]
        home_rating := ratings[item.home]
        away_rating := ratings[item.away]
        probability := expected_score(home_rating, away_rating, real64(home_advantage))
        weight := multiplier(item, home_rating, away_rating, real64(home_advantage))
        change := real64(k_factor) * weight * (real64(item.y) - probability)
        ratings[item.home] = home_rating + change
        ratings[item.away] = away_rating - change
        expected = expected.append(probability)
        changes = changes.append(change)
        if position + 1 == int(#matches) or matches[position + 1].round != item.round
            round_ratings = round_ratings.append(ratings)
    return EloRun(ratings, expected, changes, round_ratings)

import math

real64 sigma(real64 value)
    return 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-value))

class Link(real64 alpha, real64 beta)

Link fit_link(real64[] features, real[] results, int iterations)
    real64 alpha := 0.0
    real64 beta := 0.0
    for: iteration < iterations
        real64 g0 := 0.0
        real64 g1 := 0.0
        real64 h00 := 0.0
        real64 h01 := 0.0
        real64 h11 := 0.0
        for: index < int(#features)
            z := features[index]
            p := sigma(alpha + beta * z)
            w := p * (1.0 - p)
            difference := real64(results[index]) - p
            g0 += difference
            g1 += difference * z
            h00 += w
            h01 += w * z
            h11 += w * z * z
        det := h00 * h11 - h01 * h01
        next_alpha := alpha + (h11 * g0 - h01 * g1) / det
        beta += (h00 * g1 - h01 * g0) / det
        alpha = next_alpha
    return Link(alpha, beta)

real64 log_loss(real64 p, real y)
    return if y == real(1) then -math.log(p) elif y == real(0) then -math.log(1.0 - p) else -(math.log(p) / 2.0 + math.log(1.0 - p) / 2.0)

real64 brier_score(real64 p, real y)
    difference := p - real64(y)
    return difference * difference

real correctness(real64 p, real y)
    if y == real(1) / real(2)
        return y
    return if (p > 0.5 and y == real(1)) or (p < 0.5 and y == real(0)) then real(1) else real(0)

real[] average_ranks(real[] values)
    real[] ranks := []
    for value := values[]
        greater := 0
        equal := 0
        for other := values[]
            if other > value
                greater += 1
            if other == value
                equal += 1
        ranks = ranks.append(real(greater) + real(equal + 1) / real(2))
    return ranks

int direction(real first, real second)
    return if first > second then 1 elif first < second then -1 else 0

real kendall_tau(real[] first, real[] second)
    count := int(#first)
    concordant := 0
    discordant := 0
    for: t < count
        for: t + 1 <= u < count
            agreement := direction(first[t], first[u]) * direction(second[t], second[u])
            if agreement > 0
                concordant += 1
            elif agreement < 0
                discordant += 1
    return real(concordant - discordant) / real(count * (count - 1) / 2)

real spearman_rho(real[] first, real[] second)
    count := int(#first)
    first_ranks := average_ranks(first)
    second_ranks := average_ranks(second)
    squares := real(0)
    for: index < count
        difference := first_ranks[index] - second_ranks[index]
        squares += difference * difference
    return real(1) - real(6) * squares / real(count * (count * count - 1))

import season = "./season.qui"

class BradleyTerry(real64[] strengths, real64 home_factor)

BradleyTerry bradley_terry(int team_count, season.Match[] matches, int iterations)
    wins := array(nat(team_count), fill = real(0))
    home_wins := real(0)
    for item := matches[]
        wins[item.home] += item.y
        wins[item.away] += real(1) - item.y
        home_wins += item.y
    real64[] strengths := array(nat(team_count), fill = 1.0)
    real64 theta := 1.0
    for: iteration < iterations
        real64[] zeta := array(nat(team_count), fill = 0.0)
        for item := matches[]
            q := theta * strengths[item.home] + strengths[item.away]
            zeta[item.home] += theta / q
            zeta[item.away] += 1.0 / q
        for: team < team_count
            strengths[team] = real64(wins[team]) / zeta[team]
        real64 strength_sum := 0.0
        for strength := strengths[]
            strength_sum += strength
        for: team < team_count
            strengths[team] = strengths[team] * real64(team_count) / strength_sum
        real64 denominator := 0.0
        for item := matches[]
            home := strengths[item.home]
            denominator += home / (theta * home + strengths[item.away])
        theta = real64(home_wins) / denominator
    return BradleyTerry(strengths, theta)

class OffenseDefense(real64[] offense, real64[] defense, real64[] ratings)

OffenseDefense offense_defense(int team_count, season.Match[] matches, int iterations)
    int[][] points := array(nat(team_count), fill = array(nat(team_count), fill = 0))
    for item := matches[]
        points[item.home][item.away] += item.away_score
        points[item.away][item.home] += item.home_score
    real64[] offense := array(nat(team_count), fill = 0.0)
    real64[] defense := array(nat(team_count), fill = 1.0)
    for: iteration < iterations
        for: j < team_count
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: i < team_count
                total += real64(points[i][j]) / defense[i]
            offense[j] = total
        for: i < team_count
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: j < team_count
                total += real64(points[i][j]) / offense[j]
            defense[i] = total
    real64[] ratings := []
    for: team < team_count
        ratings = ratings.append(offense[team] / defense[team])
    return OffenseDefense(offense, defense, ratings)

import math
import season = "./season.qui"

real64[] cholesky_solve(real64[][] matrix, real64[] vector)
    size := int(#vector)
    real64[][] lower := array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0))
    for: i < size
        for: j <= i
            real64 total := 0.0
            for: k < j
                total += lower[i][k] * lower[j][k]
            lower[i][j] = if j < i then (matrix[i][j] - total) / lower[j][j] else math.sqrt(matrix[i][i] - total)
    real64[] forward := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    for: i < size
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: k < i
            total += lower[i][k] * forward[k]
        forward[i] = (vector[i] - total) / lower[i][i]
    real64[] solution := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    i := size - 1
    while i >= 0
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: i + 1 <= k < size
            total += lower[k][i] * solution[k]
        solution[i] = (forward[i] - total) / lower[i][i]
        i -= 1
    return solution

real64[] gaussian_solve(real64[][] matrix, real64[] vector)
    size := int(#vector)
    for: k < size
        pivot := k
        for: k + 1 <= row < size
            if math.abs(matrix[row][k]) > math.abs(matrix[pivot][k])
                pivot = row
        saved_row := matrix[k]
        matrix[k] = matrix[pivot]
        matrix[pivot] = saved_row
        saved_value := vector[k]
        vector[k] = vector[pivot]
        vector[pivot] = saved_value
        for: k + 1 <= i < size
            factor := matrix[i][k] / matrix[k][k]
            for: k <= j < size
                matrix[i][j] -= factor * matrix[k][j]
            vector[i] -= factor * vector[k]
    real64[] solution := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    i := size - 1
    while i >= 0
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: i + 1 <= j < size
            total += matrix[i][j] * solution[j]
        solution[i] = (vector[i] - total) / matrix[i][i]
        i -= 1
    return solution

real64[] colley_ratings(int team_count, season.Match[] matches)
    real64[][] matrix := array(nat(team_count), fill = array(nat(team_count), fill = 0.0))
    balance := array(nat(team_count), fill = 0)
    for: team < team_count
        matrix[team][team] = 2.0
    for item := matches[]
        matrix[item.home][item.home] += 1.0
        matrix[item.away][item.away] += 1.0
        matrix[item.home][item.away] -= 1.0
        matrix[item.away][item.home] -= 1.0
        if item.margin > 0
            balance[item.home] += 1
            balance[item.away] -= 1
        elif item.margin < 0
            balance[item.home] -= 1
            balance[item.away] += 1
    vector := [for value := balance[] then 1.0 + real64(value) / 2.0]
    return cholesky_solve(matrix, vector)

class Massey(real64[] ratings, real64 home_advantage)

Massey massey_ratings(int team_count, season.Match[] matches)
    size := team_count + 1
    last := team_count
    real64[][] matrix := array(nat(size), fill = array(nat(size), fill = 0.0))
    real64[] vector := array(nat(size), fill = 0.0)
    for item := matches[]
        home := item.home
        away := item.away
        matrix[home][home] += 1.0
        matrix[away][away] += 1.0
        matrix[home][away] -= 1.0
        matrix[away][home] -= 1.0
        matrix[home][last] += 1.0
        matrix[last][home] += 1.0
        matrix[away][last] -= 1.0
        matrix[last][away] -= 1.0
        matrix[last][last] += 1.0
        vector[home] += real64(item.margin)
        vector[away] -= real64(item.margin)
        vector[last] += real64(item.margin)
    matrix[team_count - 1] = array(nat(team_count), fill = real64(1.0)).append(0.0)
    vector[team_count - 1] = 0.0
    solution := gaussian_solve(matrix, vector)
    return Massey(solution[0:<team_count], solution[last])

import math
import season = "./season.qui"
import elo_model = "./elo.qui"
import linear = "./linear_models.qui"
import iterative = "./iterative_models.qui"
import assessment = "./evaluation.qui"
import report = "./report.qui"

string[] comparison_labels()
    return ["standings", "elo", "colley", "massey", "bt", "od", "winpct", "rpi", "pythag"]
string[] prediction_labels()
    return ["base", "elo", "colley", "massey", "bt", "od", "winpct", "ensemble"]
string[] link_labels()
    return ["colley", "massey", "od", "winpct"]
int[] link_model_positions()
    return [2, 3, 5, 6]

real64 mean(real64[] values)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for value := values[]
        total += value
    return total / real64(#values)

real exact_sum(real[] values)
    total := real(0)
    for value := values[]
        total += value
    return total

int[] ordered(real[] values, descending := false, int[] tiebreaks := [])
    int[] result := []
    for: index < int(#values)
        position := int(#result)
        result = result.append(index)
        while position > 0
            previous := result[position - 1]
            before := if descending then values[index] > values[previous] else values[index] < values[previous]
            if values[index] == values[previous] and #tiebreaks > 0
                before = tiebreaks[index] < tiebreaks[previous]
            if not before
                break
            result[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        result[position] = index
    return result

int[] competition_ranks(real[] values)
    int[] result := []
    for value := values[]
        rank := 1
        for other := values[]
            if other > value
                rank += 1
        result = result.append(rank)
    return result

string result_letter(int scored, int conceded)
    return if scored > conceded then "W" elif scored == conceded then "D" else "L"

string result_code(real y)
    return if y == real(1) then "H" elif y == real(0) then "A" else "D"

string[] join_parts(string[][] parts)
    string[] lines := []
    for part := parts[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(part)
    return lines

class Appearance(season.Match game, local int team)
    bool home := game.home == team
    int opponent := if home then game.away else game.home
    int scored := if home then game.home_score else game.away_score
    int conceded := if home then game.away_score else game.home_score
    letter := result_letter(scored, conceded)

Appearance[] appearances_of(int team, season.Match[] matches)
    return [for item := matches[] if item.home == team or item.away == team then Appearance(item, team)]

string record_text(Appearance[] appearances)
    won := 0
    drawn := 0
    lost := 0
    for item := appearances[]
        if item.letter == "W"
            won += 1
        elif item.letter == "D"
            drawn += 1
        else
            lost += 1
    return "{won}-{drawn}-{lost}"

class Record()
    played := 0
    won := 0
    drawn := 0
    lost := 0
    scored := 0
    conceded := 0
    points := 0

    void .add(int score, int against, season.Settings config)
        played += 1
        scored += score
        conceded += against
        if score > against
            won += 1
            points += config.win_points
        elif score == against
            drawn += 1
            points += config.draw_points
        else
            lost += 1

    int difference()
        return scored - conceded

    real win_percentage()
        return real(2 * won + drawn) / real(2 * played)

Record[] team_records(int team_count, season.Match[] matches, season.Settings settings)
    records := [for index := (0:<team_count)[] then Record()]
    for item := matches[]
        .records[item.home].add(item.home_score, item.away_score, settings)
        .records[item.away].add(item.away_score, item.home_score, settings)
    return records

class Standings(local int count, local season.Match[] schedule, local season.Settings config)
    records := team_records(count, schedule, config)
    h2h_points := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    h2h_difference := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    int[] order := []
    positions := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for item := schedule[]
        if records[item.home].points == records[item.away].points
            h2h_difference[item.home] += item.margin
            h2h_difference[item.away] -= item.margin
            if item.margin > 0
                h2h_points[item.home] += config.win_points
            elif item.margin < 0
                h2h_points[item.away] += config.win_points
            else
                h2h_points[item.home] += config.draw_points
                h2h_points[item.away] += config.draw_points
    for: index < count
        place := int(#order)
        order = order.append(index)
        while place > 0 and precedes(index, order[place - 1])
            order[place] = order[place - 1]
            place -= 1
        order[place] = index
    for: place < count
        positions[order[place]] = place + 1

    bool precedes(int first_team, int second_team)
        int[] first_values := [records[first_team].points, h2h_points[first_team], h2h_difference[first_team], records[first_team].difference(), records[first_team].scored]
        int[] second_values := [records[second_team].points, h2h_points[second_team], h2h_difference[second_team], records[second_team].difference(), records[second_team].scored]
        for: key < int(#first_values)
            if first_values[key] != second_values[key]
                return first_values[key] > second_values[key]
        return first_team < second_team

    int[][] tied_groups()
        int[][] groups := []
        for member := order[]
            last := int(#groups) - 1
            if last >= 0 and records[groups[last][0]].points == records[member].points
                groups[last] = groups[last].append(member)
            else
                groups = groups.append([member])
        return [for group := groups[] if #group > 1 then group]

class Streak(int length, int first, int last)

Streak longest_streak(Appearance[] appearances, string letters)
    best := Streak(0, 0, 0)
    start := 0
    length := 0
    for: index < int(#appearances)
        item := appearances[index]
        if not letters.contains(item.letter)
            length = 0
            continue
        if length == 0
            start = index
        length += 1
        if length > best.length
            best = Streak(length, appearances[start].game.round, item.game.round)
    return best

string current_streak(Appearance[] appearances)
    last := appearances[-1].letter
    count := 0
    for item := appearances[::-1][]
        if item.letter != last
            break
        count += 1
    return "{last}{count}"

class ModelFit(local int count, local season.Match[] schedule, local season.Settings config)
    elo_model.EloRun elo_run := elo_model.run_elo(count, schedule, config.elo_k, config.elo_home, config.elo_initial)
    real64[] colley := linear.colley_ratings(count, schedule)
    local fitted_massey := linear.massey_ratings(count, schedule)
    real64[] massey := fitted_massey.ratings
    real64 home_advantage := fitted_massey.home_advantage
    local fitted_bt := iterative.bradley_terry(count, schedule, config.bt_iterations)
    real64[] strengths := fitted_bt.strengths
    real64 home_factor := fitted_bt.home_factor
    local fitted_od := iterative.offense_defense(count, schedule, config.od_iterations)
    real64[] offense := fitted_od.offense
    real64[] defense := fitted_od.defense
    real64[] od := fitted_od.ratings
    real[] win_percentages := [for item := team_records(count, schedule, config)[] then item.win_percentage()]

    real64 feature(int model_index, season.Match item)
        if model_index == 0
            return colley[item.home] - colley[item.away]
        if model_index == 1
            return massey[item.home] - massey[item.away]
        if model_index == 2
            return math.log(od[item.home]) - math.log(od[item.away])
        return real64(win_percentages[item.home]) - real64(win_percentages[item.away])

    real64 bt_probability(season.Match item)
        home := home_factor * strengths[item.home]
        return home / (home + strengths[item.away])

    real64 predicted_margin(season.Match item)
        return massey[item.home] - massey[item.away] + home_advantage

class Prediction(season.Match game, real64[] probabilities, real64 margin_error)
    real64[] losses := [for p := probabilities[] then assessment.log_loss(p, game.y)]
    real64[] briers := [for p := probabilities[] then assessment.brier_score(p, game.y)]
    real[] correctness_scores := [for p := probabilities[] then assessment.correctness(p, game.y)]

class ValidationRound(int number, local int count, local season.Match[] schedule, local season.Settings config)
    season.Match[] training := season.matches_before(schedule, number)
    fitted := ModelFit(count, training, config)
    local results := [for item := training[] then item.y]
    base := real64(exact_sum(results) / real(#results))
    assessment.Link[] links := []
    Prediction[] predictions := []
    for: model_index < 4
        real64[] features := [for item := training[] then fitted.feature(model_index, item)]
        links = links.append(assessment.fit_link(features, results, config.link_iterations))
    for item := schedule[]
        if item.round == number
            predictions = predictions.append(predict(item, config))

    Prediction predict(season.Match item, season.Settings parameters)
        link_positions := link_model_positions()
        real64[] probabilities := array(8, fill = 0.0)
        probabilities[0] = base
        probabilities[1] = elo_model.expected_score(fitted.elo_run.ratings[item.home], fitted.elo_run.ratings[item.away], real64(parameters.elo_home))
        for: model_index < 4
            link := links[model_index]
            probabilities[link_positions[model_index]] = assessment.sigma(link.alpha + link.beta * fitted.feature(model_index, item))
        probabilities[4] = fitted.bt_probability(item)
        real64 total := 0.0
        for: 1 <= index <= 6
            total += probabilities[index]
        probabilities[7] = total / 6.0
        return Prediction(item, probabilities, real64(item.margin) - fitted.predicted_margin(item))

class ModelScores(local Prediction[] items)
    real64[] losses := []
    real64[] briers := []
    real64[] skills := []
    real[] accuracies := []
    int[] loss_ranking := []
    int[] brier_ranking := []
    int[] accuracy_ranking := []
    for: index < 8
        losses = losses.append(mean([for item := items[] then item.losses[index]]))
        briers = briers.append(mean([for item := items[] then item.briers[index]]))
        skills = skills.append(1.0 - briers[index] / briers[0])
        accuracies = accuracies.append(exact_sum([for item := items[] then item.correctness_scores[index]]) / real(#items))
    loss_ranking = ordered([for value := losses[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)])
    brier_ranking = ordered([for value := briers[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)])
    accuracy_ranking = ordered(accuracies, true)

class Projection(local int count, local season.Match[] schedule, local season.Settings config)
    local season.Match[] played_matches := season.matches_before(schedule, config.holdout_round)
    current := Standings(count, played_matches, config)
    real64[] ratings := elo_model.run_elo(count, played_matches, config.elo_k, config.elo_home, config.elo_initial).ratings
    season.Match[] remaining := [for item := schedule[] if item.round >= config.holdout_round then item]
    total_points := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    titles := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    tops := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    bottoms := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    int[] order := []
    ranks := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    local probabilities := [for item := remaining[] then elo_model.expected_score(ratings[item.home], ratings[item.away], real64(config.elo_home))]
    local generator_state := config.seed
    for: simulation < config.simulations
        int[] points := [for item := current.records[] then item.points]
        for: index < int(#remaining)
            item := remaining[index]
            generator_state = 48271 * generator_state % 2147483647
            uniform := real64(generator_state) / 2147483647.0
            winner := if uniform < probabilities[index] then item.home else item.away
            points[winner] += config.win_points
        simulated_order := ordered([for value := points[] then real(value)], true, current.positions)
        for: place < count
            team := simulated_order[place]
            total_points[team] += points[team]
            if place == 0
                titles[team] += 1
            if place < config.top_positions
                tops[team] += 1
            if place >= count - config.bottom_positions
                bottoms[team] += 1
    order = ordered([for value := total_points[] then real(value)], true, current.positions)
    for: place < count
        ranks[order[place]] = place + 1

    real64 opponent_strength(int team)
        real64[] values := []
        for item := remaining[]
            if item.home == team
                values = values.append(ratings[item.away])
            elif item.away == team
                values = values.append(ratings[item.home])
        return mean(values)

real opponent_average(Appearance[] appearances, real[] values)
    total := real(0)
    for item := appearances[]
        total += values[item.opponent]
    return total / real(#appearances)

class LeagueAnalysis(local season.Season source)
    season.Team[] teams := source.teams
    season.Match[] matches := source.matches
    season.Settings settings := source.settings
    team_count := int(#teams)
    int final_round := matches[-1].round
    Appearance[][] appearances := [for team := teams[] then appearances_of(team.index, matches)]
    final_table := Standings(team_count, matches, settings)
    fitted := ModelFit(team_count, matches, settings)
    Standings[] round_tables := [for number := (1:final_round)[] then Standings(team_count, season.matches_before(matches, number + 1), settings)]
    Streak[] win_streaks := [for items := appearances[] then longest_streak(items, "W")]
    Streak[] unbeaten_streaks := [for items := appearances[] then longest_streak(items, "WD")]
    real[] sos := [for items := appearances[] then opponent_average(items, fitted.win_percentages)]
    real[] sos2 := [for items := appearances[] then opponent_average(items, sos)]
    real[] rpi := [for index := (0:<team_count)[] then (fitted.win_percentages[index] + real(2) * sos[index] + sos2[index]) / real(4)]
    real64[] pythag := [for item := final_table.records[] then 1.0 / (1.0 + (real64(item.conceded) / real64(item.scored)) ^ settings.pythagorean_exponent)]
    real64[] luck := [for index := (0:<team_count)[] then real64(fitted.win_percentages[index]) - pythag[index]]
    real[][] comparison := [
        [for position := final_table.positions[] then real(-position)],
        [for value := fitted.elo_run.ratings[] then report.decimal_value(value, 2)],
        [for value := fitted.colley[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)],
        [for value := fitted.massey[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)],
        [for value := fitted.strengths[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)],
        [for value := fitted.od[] then report.decimal_value(value, 2)],
        fitted.win_percentages,
        rpi,
        [for value := pythag[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)]
    ]
    int[][] model_ranks := [for values := comparison[1:<7][] then competition_ranks(values)]
    ValidationRound[] rounds := [for number := (settings.holdout_round:final_round)[] then ValidationRound(number, team_count, matches, settings)]
    Prediction[] predictions := []
    for validation := rounds[]
        predictions = predictions.concat(validation.predictions)
    scores := ModelScores(predictions)
    projection := Projection(team_count, matches, settings)

    string code(int team)
        return teams[team].code

    string[] standings_lines()
        lines := ["pos,team,name,played,won,drawn,lost,scored,conceded,diff,points,home,away,form,streak,close,longest_win,longest_unbeaten,winpct,sos,sos2,rpi,pythag,luck"]
        for team := final_table.order[]
            Record item := final_table.records[team]
            played := appearances[team]
            home := [for entry := played[] if entry.home then entry]
            away := [for entry := played[] if not entry.home then entry]
            close := [for entry := played[] if math.abs(entry.scored - entry.conceded) <= settings.close_margin then entry]
            form := [for entry := played[int(#played) - settings.form_length:<#played][] then entry.letter].join("")
            string[] fields := [
                "{final_table.positions[team]}", code(team), teams[team].name, "{item.played}", "{item.won}", "{item.drawn}", "{item.lost}", "{item.scored}", "{item.conceded}", "{item.difference()}", "{item.points}",
                record_text(home), record_text(away), form, current_streak(played), record_text(close), "{win_streaks[team].length}", "{unbeaten_streaks[team].length}",
                report.fraction_text(fitted.win_percentages[team]), report.fixed(sos[team]), report.fixed(sos2[team]), report.fixed(rpi[team]), report.fixed(pythag[team]), report.fixed(luck[team])
            ]
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] ratings_lines()
        int[] totals := []
        for: team < team_count
            total := 0
            for values := model_ranks[]
                total += values[team]
            totals = totals.append(total)
        consensus_order := ordered([for value := totals[] then real(value)])
        lines := ["team,elo,elo_rank,colley,colley_rank,massey,massey_rank,bt,bt_rank,offense,defense,od,od_rank,winpct,winpct_rank,consensus,best_rank,worst_rank"]
        for team := consensus_order[]
            ranks := [for values := model_ranks[] then values[team]]
            string[] fields := [
                code(team), report.fixed(fitted.elo_run.ratings[team], 2), "{ranks[0]}", report.fixed(fitted.colley[team]), "{ranks[1]}", report.fixed(fitted.massey[team]), "{ranks[2]}",
                report.fixed(fitted.strengths[team]), "{ranks[3]}", report.fixed(fitted.offense[team], 2), report.fixed(fitted.defense[team]), report.fixed(fitted.od[team], 2), "{ranks[4]}",
                report.fixed(fitted.win_percentages[team]), "{ranks[5]}", "{totals[team]}", "{ranks.min()}", "{ranks.max()}"
            ]
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] history_lines()
        lines := ["round,team,elo,change,elo_rank,points,position"]
        previous := array(nat(team_count), fill = real64(settings.elo_initial))
        for: index < final_round
            table := round_tables[index]
            real64[] ratings := fitted.elo_run.round_ratings[index]
            ranks := competition_ranks([for value := ratings[] then report.decimal_value(value, 2)])
            for: team < team_count
                lines = lines.append(["{index + 1}", code(team), report.fixed(ratings[team], 2), report.fixed(ratings[team] - previous[team], 2), "{ranks[team]}", "{table.records[team].points}", "{table.positions[team]}"].join(","))
            previous = ratings
        return lines

    string[] summary_lines()
        results := [for item := matches[] then item.y]
        home_won := 0
        drawn := 0
        home_lost := 0
        for y := results[]
            if y == real(1)
                home_won += 1
            elif y == real(0)
                home_lost += 1
            else
                drawn += 1
        rate := exact_sum(results) / real(#results)
        return [
            "season teams {team_count} matches {#matches} rounds {final_round}",
            "home won {home_won} drawn {drawn} lost {home_lost} rate {report.fraction_with_real(rate)}",
            "massey_home_advantage {report.fixed(fitted.home_advantage)}",
            "bt_home_factor {report.fixed(fitted.home_factor)}"
        ]

    string[] upset_lines()
        int[] candidates := []
        real64[] expectations := []
        for: index < int(#matches)
            if matches[index].margin != 0
                candidates = candidates.append(index)
                expectations = expectations.append(if matches[index].margin > 0 then fitted.elo_run.expected[index] else 1.0 - fitted.elo_run.expected[index])
        upset_order := ordered([for value := expectations[] then report.decimal_value(value, 4)])
        lines := ["upsets top {settings.upsets}"]
        for: position < math.min(settings.upsets, int(#candidates))
            candidate := upset_order[position]
            index := candidates[candidate]
            item := matches[index]
            home_win := item.margin > 0
            winner := if home_win then item.home else item.away
            loser := if home_win then item.away else item.home
            winner_score := if home_win then item.home_score else item.away_score
            loser_score := if home_win then item.away_score else item.home_score
            side := if home_win then "home" else "away"
            lines = lines.append("round {item.round} {code(winner)} beat {code(loser)} {winner_score}-{loser_score} {side} expected {report.fixed(expectations[candidate])} gain {report.fixed(math.abs(fitted.elo_run.changes[index]), 2)}")
        return lines

    string[] tiebreak_lines()
        lines := ["tiebreaks"]
        for group := final_table.tied_groups()[]
            string[] team_codes := [for team := group[] then code(team)]
            group_points := [for team := group[] then "{final_table.h2h_points[team]}"]
            group_difference := [for team := group[] then "{final_table.h2h_difference[team]}"]
            lines = lines.append("points {final_table.records[group[0]].points} order {team_codes.join(" ")} h2h_points {group_points.join(" ")} h2h_diff {group_difference.join(" ")}")
        if #lines == 1
            lines = lines.append("none")
        return lines

    string[] leader_lines()
        lines := ["leaders"]
        previous := -1
        recorded := 0
        for: index < final_round
            table := round_tables[index]
            leader := table.order[0]
            if leader != previous
                lines = lines.append("round {index + 1} {code(leader)} points {table.records[leader].points}")
                recorded += 1
            previous = leader
        return lines.append("lead_changes {recorded - 1}")

    string[] streak_lines()
        string[] lines := []
        collections := [win_streaks, unbeaten_streaks]
        labels := ["longest_win_streak", "longest_unbeaten_streak"]
        for: index < 2
            longest := [for item := collections[index][] then item.length].max()
            for: team < team_count
                streak := collections[index][team]
                if streak.length == longest
                    lines = lines.append("{labels[index]} {code(team)} length {streak.length} rounds {streak.first}-{streak.last}")
        return lines

    string[] crosstable_lines()
        int[] top := final_table.order[0:<settings.top_positions]
        string[] lines := ["crosstable top {settings.top_positions}", "team " + [for team := top[] then code(team)].join(" ")]
        for first_team := top[]
            string[] entries := []
            for second_team := top[]
                meetings := [for item := appearances[first_team][] if item.opponent == second_team then item]
                entries = entries.append(if first_team == second_team then "-" else record_text(meetings))
            lines = lines.append(code(first_team) + " " + entries.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] trajectory_lines()
        lines := ["trajectories"]
        for: team < team_count
            real64[] ratings := [for snapshot := fitted.elo_run.round_ratings[] then snapshot[team]]
            rounded := [for value := ratings[] then report.decimal_value(value, 2)]
            int[] positions := [for table := round_tables[] then table.positions[team]]
            peak := 0
            low := 0
            best := 0
            worst := 0
            for: 1 <= index < final_round
                if rounded[index] > rounded[peak]
                    peak = index
                if rounded[index] < rounded[low]
                    low = index
                if positions[index] < positions[best]
                    best = index
                if positions[index] > positions[worst]
                    worst = index
            lines = lines.append("{code(team)} elo_peak {report.fixed(ratings[peak], 2)} round {peak + 1} elo_low {report.fixed(ratings[low], 2)} round {low + 1} best_position {positions[best]} round {best + 1} worst_position {positions[worst]} round {worst + 1}")
        return lines

    string[] correlation_lines(bool spearman)
        comparison_names := comparison_labels()
        title := if spearman then "spearman" else "kendall"
        lines := [title, "model " + comparison_names.join(" ")]
        for: first_model < 9
            string[] values := []
            for: second_model < 9
                coefficient := if spearman then assessment.spearman_rho(comparison[first_model], comparison[second_model]) else assessment.kendall_tau(comparison[first_model], comparison[second_model])
                values = values.append(report.fraction_text(coefficient))
            lines = lines.append(comparison_names[first_model] + " " + values.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] similarity_lines()
        comparison_names := comparison_labels()
        most_first := 0
        most_second := 1
        least_first := 0
        least_second := 1
        most := assessment.kendall_tau(comparison[0], comparison[1])
        least := most
        for: first_model < 9
            for: first_model + 1 <= second_model < 9
                coefficient := assessment.kendall_tau(comparison[first_model], comparison[second_model])
                if coefficient > most
                    most = coefficient
                    most_first = first_model
                    most_second = second_model
                if coefficient < least
                    least = coefficient
                    least_first = first_model
                    least_second = second_model
        return [
            "most_similar {comparison_names[most_first]} {comparison_names[most_second]} tau {report.fraction_with_real(most)}",
            "least_similar {comparison_names[least_first]} {comparison_names[least_second]} tau {report.fraction_with_real(least)}"
        ]

    string[] season_lines()
        return join_parts([summary_lines(), upset_lines(), tiebreak_lines(), leader_lines(), streak_lines(), crosstable_lines(), trajectory_lines(), correlation_lines(false), correlation_lines(true), similarity_lines()])

    string[] prediction_lines()
        prediction_names := prediction_labels()
        lines := ["round,home,away,home_score,away_score,result," + prediction_names.join(",")]
        for prediction := predictions[]
            item := prediction.game
            string[] fields := ["{item.round}", code(item.home), code(item.away), "{item.home_score}", "{item.away_score}", result_code(item.y)]
            fields = fields.concat([for p := prediction.probabilities[] then report.fixed(p)])
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] link_lines()
        link_names := link_labels()
        lines := ["links"]
        for validation := rounds[]
            parts := ["round {validation.number} train {#validation.training} base {report.fixed(validation.base)} bt_home {report.fixed(validation.fitted.home_factor)}"]
            for: index < 4
                link := validation.links[index]
                parts = parts.append("{link_names[index]} {report.fixed(link.alpha)} {report.fixed(link.beta)}")
            lines = lines.append(parts.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] score_lines()
        prediction_names := prediction_labels()
        lines := ["scores", "model log_loss brier skill accuracy"]
        for: index < 8
            lines = lines.append("{prediction_names[index]} {report.fixed(scores.losses[index])} {report.fixed(scores.briers[index])} {report.fixed(scores.skills[index])} {report.fraction_with_real(scores.accuracies[index])}")
        int[][] rankings := [scores.loss_ranking, scores.brier_ranking, scores.accuracy_ranking]
        labels := ["ranking_log_loss", "ranking_brier", "ranking_accuracy"]
        for: index < 3
            lines = lines.append(labels[index] + " " + [for model_index := rankings[index][] then prediction_names[model_index]].join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] paired_lines()
        prediction_names := prediction_labels()
        int reference := scores.loss_ranking[0]
        sample_count := real64(#predictions)
        lines := ["paired_log_loss reference " + prediction_names[reference]]
        for: index < 8
            if index == reference
                continue
            deltas := [for item := predictions[] then item.losses[index] - item.losses[reference]]
            average := mean(deltas)
            real64 squares := 0.0
            for delta := deltas[]
                squares += (delta - average) * (delta - average)
            spread := math.sqrt(squares / (sample_count - 1.0))
            real64 t_value := average / (spread / math.sqrt(sample_count))
            lines = lines.append("{prediction_names[index]} mean_diff {report.fixed(average)} sd {report.fixed(spread)} t {report.fixed(t_value, 2)}")
        return lines

    string[] margin_lines()
        errors := [for item := predictions[] then item.margin_error]
        absolute := mean([for value := errors[] then math.abs(value)])
        root_squared := math.sqrt(mean([for value := errors[] then value * value]))
        return ["massey_margin mae {report.fixed(absolute)} rmse {report.fixed(root_squared)} bias {report.fixed(mean(errors))}"]

    string[] round_loss_lines()
        prediction_names := prediction_labels()
        lines := ["round_log_loss", "round " + prediction_names.join(" ")]
        for validation := rounds[]
            string[] values := []
            for: index < 8
                values = values.append(report.fixed(mean([for item := validation.predictions[] then item.losses[index]])))
            lines = lines.append("{validation.number} " + values.join(" "))
        return lines

    string[] calibration_lines()
        prediction_names := prediction_labels()
        bins := settings.calibration_bins
        lines := ["calibration bins {bins}"]
        for: index < 8
            Prediction[][] members := array(nat(bins), fill = [])
            for prediction := predictions[]
                raw_bin := math.floor(real64(bins) * prediction.probabilities[index])
                number := math.min(raw_bin + 1, bins)
                members[number - 1] = members[number - 1].append(prediction)
            for: number < bins
                group := members[number]
                prefix := "{prediction_names[index]} bin {number + 1} count {#group} predicted "
                if #group == 0
                    lines = lines.append(prefix + "- observed -")
                else
                    predicted := mean([for item := group[] then item.probabilities[index]])
                    observed := exact_sum([for item := group[] then item.game.y]) / real(#group)
                    lines = lines.append(prefix + report.fixed(predicted) + " observed " + report.fraction_text(observed))
        return lines

    string[] grid_lines()
        validation_indices := [for index := (0:<int(#matches))[] if matches[index].round >= settings.holdout_round then index]
        headings := [for home := settings.grid_home[] then "h{home}"]
        lines := ["elo_grid", "k " + headings.join(" ")]
        found := false
        best_k := 0
        best_home := 0
        real64 best_loss := 0.0
        for k_factor := settings.grid_k[]
            row := ["{k_factor}"]
            for home := settings.grid_home[]
                run := elo_model.run_elo(team_count, matches, k_factor, home, settings.elo_initial)
                loss := mean([for index := validation_indices[] then assessment.log_loss(run.expected[index], matches[index].y)])
                row = row.append(report.fixed(loss))
                if not found or report.decimal_value(loss, 4) < report.decimal_value(best_loss, 4)
                    found = true
                    best_k = k_factor
                    best_home = home
                    best_loss = loss
            lines = lines.append(row.join(" "))
        return lines.append("best k {best_k} home {best_home} log_loss {report.fixed(best_loss)}")

    real projection_tau()
        projected := [for rank := projection.ranks[] then real(-rank)]
        final_values := [for position := final_table.positions[] then real(-position)]
        return assessment.kendall_tau(projected, final_values)

    string[] evaluation_lines()
        return join_parts([
            ["holdout rounds {settings.holdout_round}-{final_round} matches {#predictions}"],
            link_lines(), score_lines(), paired_lines(), margin_lines(), round_loss_lines(), calibration_lines(), grid_lines(),
            ["projection simulations {settings.simulations} kendall {report.fraction_with_real(projection_tau())}"]
        ])

    string[] projection_lines()
        simulations := real(settings.simulations)
        lines := ["projected,team,points_now,position_now,remaining_opponent_elo,expected_points,title,top,bottom,final_points,final_position"]
        for team := projection.order[]
            string[] fields := [
                "{projection.ranks[team]}", code(team), "{projection.current.records[team].points}", "{projection.current.positions[team]}", report.fixed(projection.opponent_strength(team), 2),
                report.fixed(real(projection.total_points[team]) / simulations), report.fixed(real(projection.titles[team]) / simulations), report.fixed(real(projection.tops[team]) / simulations), report.fixed(real(projection.bottoms[team]) / simulations),
                "{final_table.records[team].points}", "{final_table.positions[team]}"
            ]
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

void analyze_league()
    analysis := LeagueAnalysis(season.load_season())
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    report.write_lines("standings.csv", analysis.standings_lines())
    report.write_lines("ratings.csv", analysis.ratings_lines())
    report.write_lines("history.csv", analysis.history_lines())
    report.write_lines("season.txt", analysis.season_lines())
    report.write_lines("predictions.csv", analysis.prediction_lines())
    report.write_lines("evaluation.txt", analysis.evaluation_lines())
    report.write_lines("projection.csv", analysis.projection_lines())

if main
    analyze_league()

string fixed<T: numeric>(T value, places := 4)
    text := if places == 2 then "{value:.2}" else "{value:.4}"
    return if text == "-0.00" then "0.00" elif text == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else text

real decimal_value(real64 value, int places)
    result := real(fixed(value, places))
    return result

string fraction_text(real value)
    canonical := string(value)
    if canonical.contains("/")
        return canonical
    denominator := 1
    parts := canonical.split(".")
    if #parts > 1
        for: digit < int(#parts[1])
            denominator *= 10
    numerator := int(value * real(denominator))
    first := if numerator < 0 then -numerator else numerator
    second := denominator
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    return "{numerator / first}/{denominator / first}"

string fraction_with_real(real value)
    return fraction_text(value) + " " + fixed(value)

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(lines.join(NL) + NL)

class Team(int index, string code, string name)

real match_result(int home_score, int away_score)
    return if home_score > away_score then real(1) elif home_score == away_score then real(1) / real(2) else real(0)

class Match(int round, int home, int away, int home_score, int away_score)
    margin := home_score - away_score
    y := match_result(home_score, away_score)

class Settings(local string[] rows)
    win_points := int(rows[0].split(" ")[1])
    draw_points := int(rows[1].split(" ")[1])
    form_length := int(rows[2].split(" ")[1])
    close_margin := int(rows[3].split(" ")[1])
    pythagorean_exponent := real64(rows[4].split(" ")[1])
    elo_k := int(rows[5].split(" ")[1])
    elo_home := int(rows[6].split(" ")[1])
    elo_initial := int(rows[7].split(" ")[1])
    int[] grid_k := [for token := rows[8].split(" ")[1:<#rows[8].split(" ")][] then int(token)]
    int[] grid_home := [for token := rows[9].split(" ")[1:<#rows[9].split(" ")][] then int(token)]
    bt_iterations := int(rows[10].split(" ")[1])
    od_iterations := int(rows[11].split(" ")[1])
    link_iterations := int(rows[12].split(" ")[1])
    holdout_round := int(rows[13].split(" ")[1])
    upsets := int(rows[14].split(" ")[1])
    calibration_bins := int(rows[15].split(" ")[1])
    simulations := int(rows[16].split(" ")[1])
    seed := int(rows[17].split(" ")[1])
    top_positions := int(rows[18].split(" ")[1])
    bottom_positions := int(rows[19].split(" ")[1])

Match[] matches_before(Match[] matches, int round_number)
    return [for item := matches[] if item.round < round_number then item]

string[] read_lines(string path)
    source_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[] lines := source_text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<#lines - 1]

class Season(Team[] teams, Match[] matches, Settings settings)

int | error team_index(map<string, int> indices, string name)
    match indices.get(name)
        int found
            return found
        none
            return error("unknown team")

Season load_season()
    Team[] teams := []
    map<string, int> indices
    team_lines := read_lines("input/teams.csv")
    for line := team_lines[1:<#team_lines][]
        parts := line.split(",")
        index := int(#teams)
        .indices.set(parts[0], index)
        teams = teams.append(Team(index, parts[0], parts[1]))
    Match[] matches := []
    match_lines := read_lines("input/matches.csv")
    for line := match_lines[1:<#match_lines][]
        parts := line.split(",")
        home := team_index(indices, parts[1])
        away := team_index(indices, parts[2])
        item := Match(int(parts[0]), home, away, int(parts[3]), int(parts[4]))
        position := int(#matches)
        matches = matches.append(item)
        while position > 0 and matches[position - 1].round > item.round
            matches[position] = matches[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        matches[position] = item
    return Season(teams, matches, Settings(read_lines("input/params.txt")))
